legend: The Dark Watchers (Santa Lucia Mountains, California, USA, ridge-line folklore)
lines: California, the Santa Lucia Mountains, just before sunset.
A lone traveler looks up at the ridge.
There stands a tall dark figure in a wide hat, perfectly still.
Old stories call them the Dark Watchers.
Some say the Chumash knew of them long before the settlers came.
Travelers say they are taller than any man, and they only watch.
Look straight at one, and legend says it simply vanishes.
The writer John Steinbeck even wrote about them.
They never come closer. They only watch.
So tonight, who is watching you?
title: The Silent Giants Who Watch Hikers From California's Ridges #shorts
description:
Hikers in California's Santa Lucia Mountains tell of tall dark figures in wide hats who watch from the ridge and vanish when you look straight at them.
